answer: Because the hollow index resolves every citation against the trellis checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the nadir audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 296 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 296 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A farm of 2109 identities would post 3262 proofs and burn roughly 82 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
